question: Find the display name of the owner of the most valuable child post (i.e., with a non-null ParentId) created in 2011 by a user who also edited at least one post that year. A post is considered 'most valuable' based on its FavoriteCount.

prediction.sql:
SELECT u.XCL_055
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052
WHERE p.XCL_040 IS NOT NULL
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', p.XCL_029) = '2011'
  AND u.XCL_052 IN (
    SELECT ph.XCL_017
    FROM postHistory ph
    WHERE ph.XCL_013 = 4
      AND STRFTIME('%Y', ph.XCL_016) = '2011'
  )
ORDER BY p.XCL_039 DESC
LIMIT 1

SELECT u.XCL_055
FROM posts p
JOIN users u ON p.XCL_033 = u.XCL_052
WHERE p.XCL_040 IS NOT NULL
  AND STRFTIME('%Y', p.XCL_029) = '2011'
  AND u.XCL_052 IN (
    SELECT ph.XCL_017
    FROM postHistory ph
    WHERE ph.XCL_013 = 4
      AND STRFTIME('%Y', ph.XCL_016) = '2011'
  )
ORDER BY p.XCL_039 DESC
LIMIT 1

posts.XCL_040 is the ParentId column (FK to posts.XCL_026). The question specifies 'non-null ParentId', so we filter for p.XCL_040 IS NOT NULL.
posts.XCL_029 is the CreationDate of the post. The question specifies 'created in 2011', so we filter for STRFTIME('%Y', p.XCL_029) = '2011'.

postHistory.XCL_013 is PostHistoryTypeId. In Stack Exchange, type 4 corresponds to 'Edit'. postHistory.XCL_016 is the CreationDate of the history entry. We check if the user (u.XCL_052) has any edit history in 2011.
posts.XCL_039 is the FavoriteCount. The question specifies 'most valuable' based on FavoriteCount, so we order by p.XCL_039 DESC.
